items.titleEn: Crackling bats and 400-foot blasts: Sights and sounds from the Canadian Futures Showcase
bodyEn: You could see it in their smiles.

From great individual performances to winning games with brand new teammates, players understood the assignment at the Blue Jays Academy Canadian Futures Showcase: not everyone gets this opportunity, so go out and have fun.

Over the course of four days, 150 of the best high school players from across Canada came together for the 12th annual edition of the event, which was held at Rogers Field at Nat Bailey Stadium in Vancouver, B.C.

It was the first time the location had been moved outside of Ontario and an opportunity for many players, including those who had taken part the last couple of years at Rogers Centre in Toronto, to suit up somewhere new.

Just as they had in previous years, they were split into six teams then put through the paces during Scout Day on Thursday, Sept. 17, with hitting, speed and fielding drills to break down all the analytics.
At the plate and armed with wood bats, 25 players cracked exit velocities over 100 mph while seven sent baseballs over 400 feet.
Topping both was Jalen Jacob (Maple, Ont.), who crushed one during batting practice 110 mph that went 425 feet.

“Just remember that this isn’t something where it’s super-serious or it’s important to win,” said Jacob. “It’s something where you’re here just to enjoy the time with the guys. Just having a good time and showing out – that’s what keeps me going.”

Sam Ellis (La Peche, Que.) had the fastest 60-yard dash with a time of 6.25 seconds, while the top throwing velocities for position players went to catcher Tanner Morris (Sudbury, Ont.) at 90 mph, infielder Cohen Miller (Calgary, Alta.) at 91 mph, and outfielders Ethan Borovilos (Etobicoke, Ont.) and Trace Pettit (Dorchester, Ont.) shared the top speed at 92 mph.
Great days for baseball
After showing their skills to the dozens of scouts in attendance, many who wouldn’t have normally made the trek to Toronto, the players shifted their focus to games.

Under the tutelage of a cast of star coaches including former Canadian MLB players like Andrew Albers, Denis Boucher, Pete Orr, Chris Reitsma, Michael Saunders and Matt Stairs, each team played four contests over the next two-and-a-half days, aiming for a berth in Sunday’s championship finale.

Dozens of professional, college and national team scouts remained in attendance throughout the round-robin games to see how each player handled game situations, while the players enjoyed the great baseball weather provided during the duration of the event.

“My biggest goal for this tournament was just to play hard and with energy,” said Toronto-born Ira Rootman, who now resides in California and also has family in Vancouver. “Stepping into this one, it’s a new environment and I’m just going to have fun with my friends and prove what I have.”

Tournament play was about more than wins and losses through, with offensive points being awarded for wins as well as bases earned and stolen bases while defensive points were awarded for catching would-be base-stealers.
By the end of Saturday’s games, Team New Blue was the only unbeaten team and had picked up numerous bonus points, while Team Royal snuck by Team Red to earn a berth in the final.
Launching baseballs into orbit
Championship Sunday began with Daril Rodriguez (Red Deer, Alta.) looking to defend his Home Run Derby crown.
He was matched up against five others, including Theo Lima (Whitby, Ont.), Gino De Santis (Chatham, Ont.), Gabriel Lehouillier (Levis, Que.), Mikey Batiste (Mississauga, Ont.), and Jacob.
Unfortunately for Rodriguez, he wasn’t able to make it out of the first round as Lima, Batiste and Jacob all advanced.

Lima pounded six out in the final round while Batiste hit four. Then Jacob stole the show, hitting seven, complete with a towering bat flip as he watched the seventh clear the tall fence in right field.
“This means everything,” said the 6-foot-2, 248-pound lefty. “It's my third year here. I fell short two times in a row, so I'm going to hang this [championship chain] up in my room, 100 percent.”
The New Blue Crew
Then it was onto the championship game, where Team New Blue asserted itself as the most complete team once again.

De Santis hit an RBI single in the bottom of the first to start the scoring and they never looked back, scoring another in the second and two runs in each of the third and fourth innings, en route to a 6-1 win over Team Royal.
Hudson Nikkel (Vauxhall, Ab.) led the team offensively, going 1-for-2 with a two-run single in the third, while Galen Hudel (Waterloo, Ont.) scored twice and added an RBI.
“Everyone wanted to do it for the guy beside them,” Hudel said about the strong team chemistry shown. “That was kind of our motto throughout the whole week was do it for the guy beside you.”
It was an unforgettable weekend for the high school players, who now return home with new knowledge and confidence knowing they are amongst the best in the country.
Team Royal infielder Dayne Liske (Drayton Valley, Alta.) – who was named Showcase MVP after hitting .455 with a 1.637 OPS, a triple, two homers and four RBIs – says no one could have asked for more.
“Not a lot of kids get to do this,” he said. “Looking back on it one day, we’ll think it was special, so being here means a lot.”
items.titleZh: 加拿大未来之星展示会：强力挥棒与400英尺本垒打
items.summaryZh: 加拿大未来之星展示会在温哥华落幕，150名顶尖高中球员展现实力。
bodyZh: 你可以从他们的笑容中看出来。
从出色的个人表现到与全新的队友一同赢下比赛，球员们深知参加多伦多蓝鸟学院加拿大未来之星展示会的意义：并非每个人都能获得这样的机会，所以尽管放手去玩，享受乐趣。
在四天的时间里，来自全加拿大各地的150名最优秀的高中球员齐聚一堂，参加了第12届年度赛事，本次比赛在不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华的纳特贝利体育场罗杰斯球场举行。
这是该赛事首次移师安大略省以外举行，对于许多球员来说——包括过去几年曾在多伦多罗杰斯中心参加过比赛的球员——这是一个在全新场地上披挂上阵的机会。
与往年一样，他们被分为六支球队，并在9月17日星期四的球探日接受了各项测试，通过击球、速度和守备训练来分解各项数据。
在木棒的加持下，有25名球员的击球初速超过了100英里/小时，同时有7名球员将棒球轰出了400英尺以外。
其中表现最抢眼的是来自安大略省马普尔的Jalen Jacob，他在击球练习中轰出了一记时速110英里、飞行距离达425英尺的本垒打。
“只需记住，这不是那种超级严肃或是非要分出胜负的场合，”Jalen Jacob说道，“你来到这里只是为了和队友们享受这段时光。玩得开心并展现自己——这就是支撑我不断前行的动力。”

来自魁北克省拉佩什的Sam Ellis以6.25秒的成绩跑出了最快的60码短跑，而各位置球员中传球速度最快的则包括捕手、来自安大略省萨德伯里的Tanner Morris（90英里/小时），内野手、来自艾伯塔省卡尔加里的Cohen Miller（91英里/小时），以及外野手、来自安大略省怡陶碧谷的Ethan Borovilos和来自安大略省多彻斯特的Trace Pettit，他们以92英里/小时的速度并列第一。
棒球的美好日子
在向现场数十名球探（其中许多人平时不会特意前往多伦多）展示了他们的技能之后，球员们的重心转移到了比赛上。
在众多明星教练的指导下，其中包括前加拿大MLB球员Andrew Albers、Denis Boucher、Pete Orr、Chris Reitsma、Michael Saunders和Matt Stairs，每支球队在接下来的两天半里进行了四场比赛，目标是争夺周日冠军决赛的席位。
在整个循环赛期间，数十位职业球探、大学球探和国家队球探始终在现场观察每位球员如何处理比赛中的各种局面，而球员们则享受着赛事期间绝佳的棒球天气。
“我参加这次比赛的最大目标就是拼尽全力、打出活力，”出生于多伦多、目前居住在加利福尼亚且在温哥华也有家人的Ira Rootman说道，“来到这里是一个全新的环境，我只想和朋友们一起享受乐趣，证明我自己的实力。”
然而，锦标赛的比赛不仅关乎胜负，进攻端会根据胜利以及获得的垒包和盗垒来给予积分，防守端则会根据抓获潜在盗垒者的表现来授予积分。
到周六比赛结束时，New Blue队成为唯一一支保持不败的球队，并获得了大量额外积分，而Royal队则险胜Red队，赢得了决赛席位。
将棒球轰向天际
冠军星期日从Daril Rodriguez（来自艾伯塔省雷德戴尔）卫冕本垒打大赛冠军开始。
他的对手包括其他五名球员，分别是Theo Lima（安大略省惠特比）、Gino De Santis（安大略省查塔姆）、Gabriel Lehouillier（魁北克省莱维斯）、Mikey Batiste（安大略省密西沙加）以及Jalen Jacob。
对Daril Rodriguez不幸的是，他在首轮便遭淘汰，Theo Lima、Mikey Batiste和Jalen Jacob均成功晋级。
Theo Lima在决赛轮轰出6支本垒打，Mikey Batiste击出4支。随后Jalen Jacob抢尽风头，轰出7支本垒打，当他的第七记本垒打飞越右外野高高的围墙时，他霸气地甩飞了球棒。
“这意味着一切，”这位身高6英尺2英寸、体重248磅的左打者说道，“这是我在这里的第三年。我连续两年功亏一篑，所以我百分之百要把这个[冠军项链]挂在我的房间里。”
New Blue队登顶
接下来是冠军争夺战，New Blue队再次展现了他们作为最全能球队的实力。
Gino De Santis在第一局下半敲出一支带打点的安打首开纪录，此后他们便一骑绝尘，第二局再得一分，第三局和第四局各取两分，最终以6比1击败Royal队。
Hudson Nikkel（艾伯塔省沃克斯霍尔）在进攻端表现出色，全场2打数1安打并在第三局贡献一支两分打点安打，而Galen Hudel（安大略省滑铁卢）则跑回两分并有一分打点。
“每个人都想为了身边的队友去拼，”Galen Hudel在谈到球队展现出的强大凝聚力时说道，“这可以说是我们整个星期的座右铭，那就是为了你身边的队友去战斗。”
对于这些高中球员来说，这是一个难忘的周末，他们带着新的知识和自信返回家乡，深知自己已跻身全国最优秀球员之列。
Royal队内野手Dayne Liske（艾伯塔省德雷顿山谷）——他以.455的打击率、1.637的攻击指数、一支三垒安打、两支本垒打和4分打点的表现被评为展示会MVP——表示没有人能奢求更多了。
“没有多少孩子能有这样的经历，”他说，“回首往事的那一天，我们会觉得这段经历弥足珍贵，所以能来到这里意义重大。”

items.titleEn: The final Top 100 Prospects list of the year has a new look
bodyEn: The Minor League playoffs have been completed. There are only a handful of players with prospect eligibility remaining left in the Major League postseason, and there will be fewer with each passing round. Time for us in prospectdom to go into offseason mode? Not so fast, friends.

The Arizona Fall League takes over our world beginning with Opening Day this Saturday. It’s like a baseball groundhog in Peoria has allowed us six more weeks of summer. But before we get to the start of our autumn and the eventual turn to winter, let’s give more of a spruce up to the Top 100 prospects list.

This isn’t a full revamp like we do for the preseason and in-season Top 100 updates. Rather, this is one of our occasional market corrections, a series of tweaks to get the rankings in a better shape ahead of the AFL, 40-man roster decisions and other offseason moves. As such, we revoted on the Top 15 completely, moved other prospects up or down 10 or more spots as needed, took a few names off the list and replaced them with fresh ones.
Let’s dive in:
Top 15

1. Jesús Made, SS, Brewers2. Franklin Arias, SS, Red Sox3. Leo De Vries, SS/3B, Athletics4. Josue De Paula, OF, Dodgers5. Kade Anderson, LHP, Mariners6. Eli Willits, SS, Nationals7. Josuar Gonzalez, SS, Giants8. Sebastian Walcott, SS/3B, Rangers9. Seth Hernandez, RHP, Pirates10. Rainiel Rodriguez, C/1B, Cardinals11. Ryan Sloan, RHP, Mariners12. Grady Emerson, SS, Rays13. Walker Jenkins, OF, Twins14. Roch Cholowsky, SS, White Sox15. Eduardo Quintero, OF, Dodgers

With Made holding onto the top spot, the headlining move here is that Arias slides above De Vries into the No. 2 spot. Boston’s top prospect completed a breakout age-20 campaign -- particularly in the power department -- and finished with a .323/.400/.557 and career-high 25 homers in 117 games between Double-A and Triple-A. Despite his age, he continued to make a ton of contact in zone in his first move to the Minors’ top level, and his slugging gains could get him to above-average pop long term, which would be hugely valuable given his defensive gifts at short give him a solid floor already anyways. He leaps over De Vries, who underwent right shoulder surgery on Sept. 14 and could need up to eight months for a full recovery.

De Paula also moves up to the Top 4 -- despite his well-known defensive limitations in the outfield -- after looking like the most talented hitting prospect in the Minors. The 21-year-old slugger got more aggressive at the plate but still managed to improve his contact rate at Double-A Tulsa and maintain his plus power. Those were big reasons why Los Angeles promoted him straight from the Texas League last month when it needed a DH replacement for Shohei Ohtani, and De Paula responded to the aggressive move by going 10-for-31 (.323) with a homer and 11 walks in 11 games with the big club.

Gonzalez and Rodriguez -- ranked 15th and 16th in our most recent list -- each jump into the Top 10 for the first time. The Giants switch-hitting shortstop continued to perform in his move stateside in the Arizona Complex League and Single-A San Jose, and he’s considered one of the most gifted defensive shortstops in the Minors, giving him true five-tool potential ahead of his 19th birthday later this month. Rodriguez had one of the greatest finishing sprints of the regular season, hitting .417/.482/.806 with 14 homers, 16 walks and only 20 strikeouts over 168 plate appearances as a 19-year-old in his final 36 games of the season with Double-A Springfield. The Cardinals will explore expanding his defensive versatility -- potentially with time at third base -- in order to find him a place in St. Louis, but Rodriguez is showing a bat that can play anywhere.

Walcott (No. 8) and Quintero (No. 15) will be the top two prospects in this year’s Fall League. The former returned from internal brace surgery in mid-July and displayed a pretty right-handed swing geared to tap into his significant raw power; next up will be proving himself defensively after making only two starts at shortstop in the regular season as he built back from the elbow injury. Quintero pushed his way into the Top 15 after displaying strong data at High-A Great Lakes that married high contact and impressive impact for an age-20 player. His approach can border on passivity with just a 33.9 percent swing rate in the Midwest League, but he otherwise deserves points for being a plus runner who could be valuable in any of the three outfield spots.
Highest risers
+19 Leo Bernal, C/1B, Cardinals (99 to 80)+17 Joseph Dzierwa, LHP, Orioles (86 to 69)+17 Marek Houston, SS, Twins (71 to 54)+17 Seaver King, SS/2B, Nationals (68 to 51)

One reason the Cardinals might explore moving Rodriguez around is that Bernal looks like he seized the club’s Major League starting catching job, both for 2027 and beyond. After a solid showing at Triple-A Memphis that featured a career-high 16 homers and a 116 wRC+ over 101 games, the switch-hitting backstop hit .284/.333/.474 with five homers in 24 games for St. Louis down the stretch. He also earned solid defensive marks across the board, including an average 1.88 second-base pop time that ranked in the Majors’ 86th percentile. He whiffed a little bit more than you’d like in his first taste of the bigs, but otherwise, he heads into the offseason with a strong (if smallish) MLB résumé for a 22-year-old backstop.

Dzierwa could have been forgiven if he’d wilted down the stretch of a breakout first full season, but that didn’t happen; in fact, he had a 2.32 ERA with 33 strikeouts and six walks over his final six starts (31 innings) for Double-A Chesapeake. The 6-foot-8 southpaw made it through 131 innings in his first Minor League campaign, and even if his changeup is the closest thing to a plus pitch in his bag right now, his exceptional command and control kept him successful throughout 2026 and fueled his rise in the ranks.

Houston looked like he was fading in August but caught fire again in September, ending his first first full season on a 10-game hitting streak in which he hit .405 with eight strikeouts and seven walks over 50 plate appearances. The 2025 16th overall pick is certainly hit-tool forward offensively, but with his strong base of speed and defense at a premium position, he’s just a few power improvements from being in more solid standing for a Top 50 spot.

After some struggles with offensive consistency in 2025, King started showing signs of a turnaround in the Arizona Fall League last year and carried that momentum into his second full season. His 21 homers (16 of which came with Triple-A Rochester) marked a new career high, and he posted a 104.9 mph 90th-percentile exit velocity and 110.9 mph max EV that made the power gains look stickier, even more so if he can lift the ball more often. His ability to play short might factor into Washington’s plans to move CJ Abrams to second base.
New faces
98. Hayden Alvarez, OF, Angels99. Enddy Azocar, OF, Orioles

Alvarez gives the Halos a third Top 100 prospect behind Arjun Nimmala (No. 34) and Tyler Bremner (No. 42). Playing in his age-19 season, Alvarez showed off a solid approach at Single-A and High-A to finish with a solid .391 on-base percentage over 118 games, and while the power still isn’t showing up in major ways yet, he did connect on a career-high 12 homers and has room in his 6-foot-3 frame to add more strength as he enters his 20s. He also has plus speed that helped him steal 53 bags in ‘26, and we considered that entire package when adding him to the T100.

Another 19-year-old, Azocar joined the Orioles system from the Red Sox in the Trade Deadline blockbuster that moved Adley Rutschman the other way. He kept on producing in his second organization, finishing with an .885 OPS, 21 homers and 20 steals across 110 games at Single-A and High-A on the year. His contact rate actually jumped almost 10 points from Greenville (69.7 percent) and Frederick (79.3) to compare two High-A assignments, and that will deserve monitoring considering he already has the potential for above-average power and speed.
Biggest droppers

-22 Billy Carlson, SS, White Sox (59 to 81)-20 Josue Briceño, C/1B, Tigers (66 to 86)-15 Josh Hammond, SS/3B, Royals (67 to 82)-13 Thomas White, LHP, Marlins (34 to 47)-13 Felnin Celesten, SS, Mariners (47 to 60)-13 Jonny Farmelo, OF, Mariners (70 to 83)-12 Demetrio Crisantes, 2B, D-backs (72 to 84)-10 Xavier Neyens, 3B/SS, Astros (90 to 100)

Carlson missed almost two months with a torn left thumb ligament from May to July and then didn’t play after Aug. 9 due to a skin infection, thus finishing out the year with only 57 games with Single-A Kannapolis. While his defense remains phenomenal, he didn’t homer once in his limited first full season and the plurality of his batted balls (41.8 percent) went the other way, causing a slip in his stock. Similarly, Briceño began his year with right wrist surgery and ended it with a right ankle sprain -- two injuries that allowed him to play only 32 games at the Minors’ upper levels. The 6-foot-4 left-handed slugger has special power, but he’s played more than 56 games in a campaign only once since reaching full-season ball in 2023.

Hammond got off to an impressive start at Single-A Columbia in his first full season, and his improved chances of sticking at shortstop only increased enthusiasm. But he only slugged .312 over his final 40 games to finish as a league-average bat in the Carolina League on the year as a whole. White, who missed much of the year with a left shoulder capsular strain, slid back to put him in a more appropriate position compared to his fellow lefty pitchers.

Celesten, who was named Northwest League MVP in ‘26, really struggled after a late-season promotion to Double-A Arkansas, where he hit .171 with a 44 wRC+ and 33.6 percent K rate no thanks to an aggressive approach that led to much swing-and-miss. It was an overall positive season for Farmelo in that he was healthy and easily cleared 100 games played for the first time in his career; the larger sample size also proved how exposed he can be to swing-and-miss against softer stuff as was the case in his 46-game turn at Double-A.

Crisantes and Neyens drop for opposite reasons. The former is a hit-tool-first second baseman who lacked significant impact after a late-season callup to Triple-A Reno with a 100.8 mph 90th-percentile EV there. (He isn’t done in 2026 with the AFL next up on his docket.) Neyens has plus-plus raw power from the left side but made contact on only 60.8 percent of his swings over 35 games with High-A Asheville. That’s when he did swing because he only offered on 30.3 percent of the pitches he saw at the level, and that’s a level of passivity that can make him a difficult evaluation heading into his age-20 season of 2027.
Moving out
Karson Milbrandt, RHP, Marlins (from 75)Steele Hall, SS, Reds (from 88)

After absolutely dominating for Double-A Pensacola to begin 2026, Milbrandt struggled to find the strike zone with any consistency at Triple-A Jacksonville, where he had an 8.39 ERA with 62 strikeouts and 52 walks in 64 1/3 innings. His three primary pitches (four-seamer, slider, sweeper) each had slugging percentages against of .460 or higher in the International League.

The Reds took Hall ninth overall in 2025 as a long-term project considering he was 17 on Draft Day, and that remains the case. However, he struggled with contact after a late July move from the Arizona Complex League to Single-A Daytona -- for example, his in-zone contact rate was in the low 70s -- and he’ll have to exhibit adjustments at the plate to get back on this list.
items.titleZh: 年度最后一份百大潜力新秀榜面貌焕然一新
items.summaryZh: 百大潜力新秀榜单迎来更新，多位球星在榜单上位置发生变动，亚利桑那秋季联赛即将开打。
bodyZh: 小联盟季后赛已经结束。在现存的大联盟季后赛球队中，仅剩少数几位仍具潜力新秀资格的球员，且随着每一轮赛事的推进人数还将减少。我们这些关注潜力新秀的人是时候进入休赛期模式了吗？朋友们，别急。
亚利桑那秋季联赛将于本周六的揭幕战开始接管我们的视线。这就好比皮奥里亚的一只棒球土拨鼠让我们多享受了六周的夏天。但在我们迎来秋天并最终转入冬天之前，让我们对百大潜力新秀榜单进行一次更多的修整。
这并不是像我们对季前和赛季中百大更新那样的大规模重组。相反，这是我们偶尔进行的市场修正之一，是一系列微调，旨在为秋季联赛、40人名单决策以及其他休赛期运作做好更充分的排名准备。因此，我们对前15名进行了完全重新投票，根据需要将其他潜力新秀上下移动了10个或更多的顺位，并从榜单中去除了一些名字，换上了新鲜血液。
让我们深入了解：
前15名

1. Jesús Made, 游击手, 密尔沃基酿酒人 2. Franklin Arias, 游击手, 波士顿红袜 3. Leo De Vries, 游击手/三垒手, 运动家 4. Josue De Paula, 外野手, 洛杉矶道奇 5. Kade Anderson, 左投, 西雅图水手 6. Eli Willits, 游击手, 华盛顿国民 7. Josuar Gonzalez, 游击手, 旧金山巨人 8. Sebastian Walcott, 游击手/三垒手, 得克萨斯游骑兵 9. Seth Hernandez, 右投, 匹兹堡海盗 10. Rainiel Rodriguez, 捕手/一垒手, 圣路易斯红雀 11. Ryan Sloan, 右投, 西雅图水手 12. Grady Emerson, 游击手, 坦帕湾光芒 13. Walker Jenkins, 外野手, 明尼苏达双城 14. Roch Cholowsky, 游击手, 芝加哥白袜 15. Eduardo Quintero, 外野手, 洛杉矶道奇

随着Made保住榜首位置，最引人注目的变动是Arias超越De Vries升至第二位。这位波士顿顶级潜力新秀完成了一个突破性的20岁赛季——尤其是在长打能力方面——在双A和三A的117场比赛中交出.323/.400/.557的打击三围，并创下生涯新高的25支本垒打。尽管年龄尚轻，在他首次升入小联盟顶级层级时，他依然在好球带内保持了极高的击球率，而他长打能力的提升可能会在远期为他带来高于平均水平的爆发力，鉴于他在游击位置上的防守天赋已经为他奠定了坚实的下限，这无论如何都将极具价值。他超越了于9月14日接受右肩手术、可能需要长达八个月才能完全康复的De Vries。

尽管De Paula在场上防守有着众所周知的局限性，但他看起来像是小联盟中最具天赋的打击新秀，这也使他跻身前四。这位21岁强打者在打击区上变得更具侵略性，但仍设法在双A图尔萨提升了击球率并保持了其出色的力量。这些都是上个月当洛杉矶需要为大谷翔平寻找指定打击替代者时，将他直接从得克萨斯联盟提拔上来的重要原因，De Paula通过在11场大联盟比赛中31打数10安打（.323打击率）、击出1支本垒打并选到11次保送的优异表现回应了这一激进的运作。

Gonzalez和Rodriguez——在我们最近的榜单中分别排名第15和第16——双双首次闯入前十。这位巨人的左右开弓游击手在来到美国本土并在亚利桑那秋季联盟和单A圣何塞出赛期间持续交出好表现，他被认为是小联盟中最具防守天赋的游击手之一，并在本月晚些时候19岁生日到来之前展现出真正的五拍子潜力。Rodriguez在常规赛收官阶段迎来了最伟大的冲刺之一，作为一名在双A斯普林菲尔德度过赛季最后36场比赛的19岁球员，他在168个打席中交出.417/.482/.806的打击三围，轰出14支本垒打，选到16次保送，仅吞下20次三振。红雀队将探索拓展他的防守多面性——可能安排三垒守备时间——以便为他在圣路易斯找到一席之地，但Rodriguez展现出的打击棒子在任何地方都能发挥作用。

Walcott（第8位）和Quintero（第15位）将是今年秋季联赛中排名最高的两名潜力新秀。前者在7月中旬从内支架手术中复出，并展示了相当出色的右打挥棒，旨在发挥他巨大的天生力量；接下来他需要在常规赛中证明自己的防守能力，由于从手肘伤势中恢复，他在常规赛中仅在游击位置首发过两次。Quintero在高级单A五大湖展现出高击球率与惊人击球力道的强劲数据后，杀入前15名，这对于一名20岁球员来说实属不易。他的打法有时近乎被动，在中西部联盟的挥棒率仅为33.9%，但除此之外，他作为一名出色的跑者赢得了认可，能够在三个外野位置上都展现价值。
上升最快的球员
+19 Leo Bernal, 捕手/一垒手, 圣路易斯红雀（从99升至80） +17 Joseph Dzierwa, 左投, 巴尔的摩金莺（从86升至69） +17 Marek Houston, 游击手, 明尼苏达双城（从71升至54） +17 Seaver King, 游击手/二垒手, 华盛顿国民（从68升至51）

红雀队可能探索轮换Rodriguez位置的一个原因是，Bernal看起来已经牢牢占据了球队大联盟的主力捕手位置，无论是2027年还是更远的未来。在三A孟菲斯有过稳健表现（在101场比赛中交出生涯新高的16支本垒打和116的wRC+）之后，这位左右开弓的捕手在圣路易斯收官阶段的24场比赛中交出.284/.333/.474的打击三围和5支本垒打。他在全方位的防守上也赢得了不错的评分，包括平均1.88秒的二垒传球时间，在全大联盟中排名第86百分位。在初登大联盟时，他吞下的三振比人们所希望的要稍微多了一些，但除此之外，对于一名22岁的捕手而言，他带着一份强劲（尽管样本较小）的大联盟履历进入休赛期。

如果Dzierwa在突破性的第一个完整赛季收官阶段表现疲软，人们本可以原谅他，但并没有发生这种情况；事实上，他在双A切萨皮克的最后六场比赛（31局）中投出了2.32的自责分率，送出33次三振和6次保送。这位身高6尺8寸的左投在他的第一个小联盟赛季中投满了131局，即便他的变速球是他目前武器库中最接近单项优质的球路，但他杰出的控球和制球能力让他在整个2026赛季都保持成功，并推动了他在榜单上的排名上升。
Houston在8月时看起来有些状态下滑，但在9月再度火热起来，以一场10场安打的连续安打秀结束了他的第一个完整赛季，在50个打席中交出.405的打击率，送出8次三振和7次保送。这位2025年整体第16顺位新秀在进攻端显然是以打击技巧见长，但凭借其出色的速度基础以及在关键防守位置上的能力，他只需在力量上做一些提升，便能在前50名的榜单中站得更稳。

在2025年进攻稳定性遭遇一些挣扎后，King在去年的亚利桑那秋季联赛中开始展现出好转迹象，并将这种势头延续到了他的第二个完整赛季。他轰出的21支本垒打（其中16支在三A罗切斯特打出）创下了生涯新高，并且交出了104.9英里的第90百分位击球初速以及110.9英里的最高击球初速，这让力量的增长看起来更加稳定，如果他能更频繁地打出高飞球，这种增长甚至会更加显著。他防守游击的能力可能会影响华盛顿将CJ Abrams移防二垒的计划。
新面孔
98. Hayden Alvarez, 外野手, 洛杉矶天使 99. Enddy Azocar, 外野手, 巴尔的摩金莺

Alvarez为天使队在Arjun Nimmala（第34位）和Tyler Bremner（第42位）之后增添了第三位百大潜力新秀。在19岁的赛季中，Alvarez在单A和高级单A展现了稳健的打击策略，在118场比赛结束时交出了.391的稳健上垒率，虽然力量尚未以重大方式展现，但他确实轰出了生涯新高的12支本垒打，并且随着他迈入20岁，他那6尺3寸的体格仍有空间增添更多力量。他还拥有出色的速度，帮助他在26赛季盗走了53个垒包，我们在将他加入百大时综合考虑了整体能力。

另一位19岁球员Azocar在交易截止日轰动性地将Adley Rutschman送往对家的交易中，从红袜队加入金莺体系。他在第二支球机构中持续产出，在单A和高级单A的110场比赛中交出.885的OPS、21支本垒打和20次盗垒。对比两个高级单A的指派，他的击球率实际上从格林维尔（69.7%）和弗雷德里克（79.3%）大幅跳升了近10个百分点，鉴于他已经具备高于平均水平的力量和速度潜力，这非常值得持续关注。
跌幅最大的球员

-22 Billy Carlson, 游击手, 芝加哥白袜（从59降至81） -20 Josue Briceño, 捕手/一垒手, 底特律老虎（从66降至86） -15 Josh Hammond, 游击手/三垒手, 堪萨斯城皇家（从67降至82） -13 Thomas White, 左投, 迈阿密马林鱼（从34降至47） -13 Felnin Celesten, 游击手, 西雅图水手（从47降至60） -13 Jonny Farmelo, 外野手, 西雅图水手（从70降至83） -12 Demetrio Crisantes, 二垒手, 亚利桑那响尾蛇（从72降至84） -10 Xavier Neyens, 三垒手/游击手, 休斯敦太空人（从90降至100）

Carlson在5月到7月期间因左手拇指韧带撕裂缺阵了近两个月，随后又因皮肤感染自8月9日后未能出场，因此整个赛季在单A坎纳波利斯仅打了57场比赛。尽管他的防守依然极其出色，但在他受限的第一个完整赛季里他没有击出一支本垒打，且他的击球多数（41.8%）被推向反方向，导致他的身价下滑。同样地，Briceño以右腕手术开始赛季，并以右脚踝扭伤结束赛季——这两次伤病使他在小联盟高级层级中仅出场32场比赛。这位身高6尺4寸的左打强打者拥有特殊的力量，但自2023年进入全赛季球季以来，他单个赛季出场超过56场的次数只有一次。
Hammond在他的第一个完整赛季在单A哥伦比亚迎来了令人印象深刻的开局，他留在游击防区几率的提升增强了人们的热情。但在最后40场比赛中，他的长打率仅为.312，最终在整个卡罗拉纳联盟中成为一名联盟平均水平的打者。White因左肩关节囊拉伤缺席了大半个赛季，他的排名有所回落，这使他与同为左投手的队友相比处于一个更合适的定位。

在26年荣获西北联盟MVP的Celesten在赛季末被提拔到双A阿肯色后陷入了极大的挣扎，在那里他交出.171的打击率、44的wRC+以及33.6%的三振率，这少不了激进打法导致大量挥空的原因。对Farmelo而言，这整体是一个积极的赛季，因为他保持了健康，职业生涯中首次轻松突破100场出场；更大的样本量也证明了他在面对较慢球速时面对挥空是多么容易暴露出弱点，就像他在双A的46场出赛中所经历的那样。

Crisantes和Neyens因相反的原因排名下跌。前者是一位以打击技巧为主的二垒手，在赛季末被提拔到三A里诺后缺乏显著的打击爆发力，其第90百分位击球初速为100.8英里。（随着秋季联赛提上日程，他在2026年的征程尚未结束。）Neyens拥有来自左侧的极佳天生力量，但在高级单A阿什维尔的35场比赛中，他的挥棒击球率仅为60.8%。这是在他确实选择挥棒的情况下，因为他在该层级面对的球中仅有30.3%选择出棒，这种被动程度使他在迈入2027年20岁赛季时成为一个很难评估的对象。
掉出榜单
Karson Milbrandt, 右投, 迈阿密马林鱼（原第75位） Steele Hall, 游击手, 辛辛那提红人（原第88位）
在2026赛季初为双A彭萨科拉展现绝对压制力之后，Milbrandt在三A杰克逊维尔难以稳定找到好球带，在那里他在64.3局中投出了8.39的自责分率，送出62次三振和52次保送。他的三种主要球路（四缝线速球、滑球、横扫滑球）在国际联盟中被对手打出的长打率均达到.460或更高。
红桃队在2025年以第9顺位选中Hall，由于他在选秀日时年仅17岁，将其视作长期培养项目，目前情况依然如此。然而，在7月下旬从亚利桑那秋季联盟转入单A代顿后，他在击球上面临挣扎——例如，他的好球带内击球率仅在70%出头——他必须在打击区做出调整才能重返这份榜单。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays GM Atkins, CEO Shapiro talk Guerrero, offseason needs
bodyEn: TORONTO -- This offseason will be long and complicated, but the Blue Jays’ problems are short and simple. They need to score more runs. That’s it.

Every conversation we have about the Blue Jays this winter will come back to their offense, which ranked last in homers (152) and runs scored (648) in 2026. Even if they cloned starter Dylan Cease and built an entire rotation out of him, this is such a frustrating way to live, forever stuck in low-scoring games and too often lacking the firepower to do much about it.
Just days after Toronto finished last place in the American League East with a 79-83 record, general manager Ross Atkins and president and CEO Mark Shapiro kept coming back to the same topic.

“Offensively, we never gained any momentum. We never put the ball in the seats,” Atkins said. “We’re not walking, we’re not getting on base nearly enough. When that happens, you’re relying on line drives in gaps. The contact just wasn’t enough.”

This offseason will bring all of the usual tinkering, likely by adding a starter or two, or perhaps some depth in the bullpen. But it feels like something more substantial is needed to fix the Blue Jays' offense, something that changes the DNA of this group and points them in a different direction.

Free agency isn’t overflowing with answers. Expect the Blue Jays to be one of the most aggressive suitors for Cubs outfielder Seiya Suzuki -- one of the most obvious fits -- while the Mariners' Randy Arozarena and the Pirates' Brandon Lowe also sit near the top of a weak position player class.

Japan could be the key to the Blue Jays’ offseason once again, one year after landing third baseman Kazuma Okamoto on a four-year, $60 million deal, which has paid dividends after he led the team with 33 homers. Looking to expand their organization’s presence in Japan both on and off the field, the Blue Jays will send a contingent across the Pacific this winter, and Shapiro may make a trip, too.

The headliner of this year's international class is Japanese star Teruaki Sato, a 27-year-old power hitter who's hit 38 home runs with the Hanshin Tigers of the Nippon Professional Baseball League in 2026. Sato also represented Team Japan at the World Baseball Classic.
The Blue Jays have worked hard to make themselves not just an option, but a destination for top talent out of Asia.
That said, just how much help this offense needs is up to one man, Vladimir Guerrero Jr.

Guerrero is coming off one of the most disappointing seasons we’ve seen from a star in this franchise’s history, hitting just nine home runs with a .688 OPS, all with the backdrop of his new 14-year, $500 million deal he signed in April 2025. That is the Blue Jays’ No. 1 problem and priority to fix.

“[Guerrero]'s such a dynamic athlete and hitter that it’s a really complex problem,” Atkins said. “Everyone in here can probably emulate his rhythm and tempo, that toe tap and how he creates that momentum. It’s a really impressive thing to watch. As he lost a little bit of that rhythm and timing pretty early in the season, it started to impact his confidence. Once it impacted his confidence, the in-game adjustments and in-season adjustments became very difficult.”

Like Atkins, Shapiro threw his support behind Guerrero, calling him “one of the most special offensive players in this game and in the history of this franchise.” Everyone within 100 miles of this ball club knows, however, that Guerrero needs to rebound in a major way for any of this to work.

“I tried to think through whether I’d experienced anything like that,” Shapiro said. “I can remember slumps with great players, players who in the past, we were dependent on for success and how that all feels, but usually they don’t last as long as this one lasted. There’s just such an overwhelming level of compassion for him because of our belief in him, the same belief that led us to where we are and the commitment we made to him.”

While the postseason rolls on without the Blue Jays, their front office will obsess over the answers to Guerrero’s problems, along with every other player on this roster. Then, the attention turns to adding, or perhaps even overhauling, this roster.

Aggression has never been the front office’s issue. They’ve traded top prospects and former first-round picks repeatedly. Backed by one of the top-spending owners in baseball, there’s no limit to what the Blue Jays could do this winter, but they’ve got to get it right. And no matter how it happens, they’ve got to score more runs in 2027.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟总经理Atkins、CEO Shapiro谈Guerrero与休赛期需求
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟管理层谈论休赛期补强方向及如何解决球队进攻火力不足的问题。
bodyZh: 多伦多讯——这个休赛期将会漫长而复杂，但多伦多蓝鸟的问题却很短小且简单。他们需要得到更多分数。就这样。
这个冬天我们关于蓝鸟的每一次讨论都会回到他们的进攻上，该队在2026年的本垒打数（152个）和得分（648分）均排名垫底。即便他们克隆一个先发投手Dylan Cease并用他组建整支轮换阵容，这种生活方式也太让人沮丧了，永远陷在低比分比赛中，并且常常缺乏足够的火力来改变现状。
就在多伦多以79胜83负的战绩在美国联盟东区垫底几天后，总经理Ross Atkins以及总裁兼CEO Mark Shapiro反复谈到了同一个话题。
“在进攻端，我们从未获得任何势头。我们没能把球打出球场，”Atkins说道。“我们没有获得足够的保送，上垒率远远不够。当这种情况发生时，你就只能依靠空当处安打。击球力度实在不够。”
这个休赛期将伴随着所有常规的小修小补，可能会引进一两名先发投手，或者增加一些牛棚深度。但感觉修复蓝鸟的进攻需要更实质性的东西，需要改变这支球队的基因并将其引向不同的方向。
自由球员市场并不缺乏答案。预计蓝鸟将成为芝加哥小熊外野手Seiya Suzuki最积极的追求者之一——这是最明显的契合点——而西雅图水手的Randy Arozarena和匹兹堡海盗的Brandon Lowe也在这份实力较弱的野手名单的头部。
在以四年6000万美元签下三垒手Kazuma Okamoto一年之后，日本可能会再次成为蓝鸟休赛期关键所在。Okamoto本赛季以33记本垒打领跑全队，这笔签约收到了回报。为了扩大该组织在场内外的日本影响力，蓝鸟今年冬天将派遣代表团跨越太平洋，Shapiro也可能会亲自前往。
今年国际球员市场的头条人物是日本球星Teruaki Sato，这位27岁的强力打者在2026年效力于日本职业棒球联盟的阪神虎队时击出了38个本垒打。Sato还代表日本队参加了世界棒球经典赛。
蓝鸟一直在努力让自己不仅成为一个选项，更成为来自亚洲的顶级人才的目的地。
话虽如此，这个进攻端到底需要多少帮助，归根结底取决于一个人，那就是Vladimir Guerrero Jr.。
Guerrero刚刚经历了一名球星在该队历史上最令人失望的赛季之一，他仅打出9个本垒打，OPS为.688，而这一切的背景是他刚刚在2025年4月签下的14年5亿美元新合同。这是蓝鸟的头号问题和首要解决任务。
“[Guerrero]是一名如此充满活力和运动能力的打者，以至于这是一个非常复杂的问题，”Atkins说道。“这里的每个人大概都能模仿他的节奏和拍子，那个点地动作以及他是如何带动势头的。这真的是一件令人印象深刻的事情。随着他在赛季初失去了一点节奏和时机，这开始影响他的自信心。一旦影响了他的自信心，比赛中的调整和赛季中的调整就变得非常困难。”
和Atkins一样，Shapiro表达了对Guerrero的支持，称他是“这项运动和本球队历史上最特殊的进攻球员之一”。然而，这支球团周围方圆百里的人都知道，Guerrero需要在很大程度上反弹，这一切才能奏效。
“我试图回想我是否经历过类似的事情，”Shapiro说道。“我能记起伟大球员的低潮，那些过去我们依赖他们来取得成功的球员，以及这一切感觉如何，但通常它们不会持续这么久。出于对他的信任，人们对他有一种压倒性的同情，正是这种信任引领我们走到今天，也是我们对他的承诺。”
当季后赛在没有蓝鸟参与的情况下继续进行时，他们的管理层将全神贯注于解决Guerrero的问题，以及名单上的每一位球员。然后，注意力将转向补强甚至彻底重组这支阵容。
积极进取从来不是管理层的难题。他们曾多次交易顶级潜力新秀和前首轮选秀权。在棒球界顶级挥霍老板之一的支持下，蓝鸟今年冬天能做的事情没有限制，但他们必须做对。无论如何，他们在2027年必须得到更多分数。

items.titleEn: Make your picks for 2026 All-MLB Team
bodyEn: Major League Baseball on Monday launched the ballot for the official All-MLB Team, which recognizes and commemorates the top performances by players during the 2026 regular season. The selections for the All-MLB Team, which was established in 2019, will be announced on Nov. 11 during the fourth annual MLB Awards from The Chelsea at The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas. Additional MLB awards to be unveiled in Las Vegas during the live show on MLB Network will include the Hank Aaron Award winners; Comeback Players of the Year; Mariano Rivera and Trevor Hoffman Relievers of the Year; Edgar Martinez Outstanding Designated Hitter of the Year; MLB Executive of the Year; and more.
Cast your All-MLB vote today

Beginning today and continuing through Friday, October 9, at 2 p.m. (ET), fans may vote for their 2026 All-MLB choices at mlb.com/allmlb each day. In addition, the ballot will be available in Spanish at mlb.com/todomlb. Fans voting on MLB.com and a decorated panel of media members, broadcasters, former players and other officials throughout the game will have equal say in determining the first-team and second-team choices who comprise the 2026 All-MLB Team.

Fans and panelists will vote for their choices at catcher, first base, second base, third base, shortstop, three outfielders (without regard for left/center/right) and designated hitter, along with five starting pitchers and two relief pitchers on both the first and second teams. All choices will be based on the 2026 regular season, without regard for American League or National League affiliation. The list of nominees that fans and panelists will choose amongst accompanies this press release.

MLB Network will preview and analyze the nominees at each position with Adnan Virk, Jake Peavy and Steve Phillips on the 2026 All-MLB Team Nominee Show tonight at 7 p.m. (ET). Following the 2026 All-MLB Team Nominee Show, MLB Network will air the 2026 MiLB Awards Show at 8 p.m. (ET).

Among the 2026 nominees are 91 All-Stars, including 62 players who appeared on 2026 All-Star rosters; 15 rookies; 65 players age 27-or-younger, including 49 players age 26-or-younger, 33 players age 25-or-younger, 20 players age 24-or-younger, and 10 players age 23-or-younger; 45 internationally born players hailing from nine countries and territories outside the 50 United States; seven Most Valuable Player Award winners; five Cy Young Award winners; 13 Rookie of the Year Award winners; two Reliever of the Year Award winners; five batting champions; and 44 previous All-MLB Team honorees, including 17 members of the 2025 All-MLB Team (nine first-team selections, eight second-team selections), 13 two-time honorees, five three-time honorees and five five-time honorees.

Los Angeles Dodgers teammates Mookie Betts, Freddie Freeman and Shohei Ohtani are joined by Houston’s Yordan Alvarez and New York Mets outfielder Juan Soto as the five players to have already been honored as a first-team or second-team selection in five seasons. Ohtani, who has captured a total of eight awards in his five winning seasons, has been selected to either team in each of his last five seasons after earning first-team honors as a designated hitter and second-team honors as a starting pitcher in 2021; first-team honors as a starting pitcher and second-team honors as a designated hitter in 2022; first-team honors in both categories in 2023; and first-team honors as a designated hitter in 2024 and 2025. Six players are aiming for an All-MLB selection in a third consecutive season, including Ketel Marte of the Arizona Diamondbacks; Paul Skenes of the Pittsburgh Pirates; Tarik Skubal of the Dodgers; Soto; Zack Wheeler of the Philadelphia Phillies; and Bobby Witt Jr. of the Kansas City Royals.

The nine All-MLB Team first-team honorees from 2025 featured on the 2026 ballot include the aforementioned Marte, Ohtani, Skenes, Skubal, Soto and Witt, along with Aroldis Chapman of the Boston Red Sox; Jhoan Duran of the Philadelphia Phillies; and Yoshinobu Yamamoto of the Dodgers.

bodyZh: 美国职棒大联盟于周一正式启动了官方全明星最佳阵容（All-MLB Team）的投票通道，该评选旨在表彰和纪念球员在2026年常规赛期间的顶级表现。设立于2019年的全明星最佳阵容人选，将于11月11日在拉斯维加斯大都会酒店The Chelsea举办的第四届年度MLB颁奖典礼上正式揭晓。届时在MLB网络频道（MLB Network）现场直播期间揭晓的其他MLB奖项还将包括：汉克·亚伦奖得主；年度最佳复出球员；马里亚诺·里维拉与特雷弗·霍夫曼年度最佳后援投手；埃德加·马丁内斯年度最佳指定打击；年度最佳俱乐部管理层（Executive of the Year）等。

从今天开始一直持续到10月9日（星期五）美东时间下午2点，球迷每天都可以前往 mlb.com/allmlb 投出他们心目中的2026年全明星最佳阵容。此外，球迷也可以通过 mlb.com/todomlb 访问西班牙语版本的投票页面。在MLB.com参与投票的球迷，以及由全联盟资深媒体人、转播商、前球员和其他官员组成的评审团，将在决定2026年全明星最佳阵容第一队和第二队人选时拥有同等的话语权。
球迷和评审团将在捕手、一垒手、二垒手、三垒手、游击手、三名外野手（不分左/中/右外野）以及指定打击位置上进行投票，两支第一队和第二队中还分别包含五名先发投手和两名后援投手。所有评选都将基于2026年常规赛的表现，不区分美国联盟或国家联盟的所属球队。供球迷和评审团进行选择的候选人名单附在本篇新闻稿后。
MLB网络频道今晚美东时间晚上7点将通过《2026年全明星最佳阵容候选人节目》（2026 All-MLB Team Nominee Show），由 Adnan Virk、Jake Peavy 和 Steve Phillips 一同为您预览和分析各个位置的候选人。在该节目之后，MLB网络频道将于美东时间晚上8点播出2026年小联盟颁奖典礼秀（MiLB Awards Show）。

在2026年的候选人中，共有91位全明星球员，其中包括62位曾入选2026年全明星赛阵容的球员；15位新秀；65位27岁及以下的球员，其中包括49位26岁及以下的球员、33位25岁及以下的球员、20位24岁及以下的球员以及10位23岁及以下的球员；45位出生于美国50州以外9个国家和地区的国际球员；7位最有价值球员奖（MVP）得主；5位赛扬奖得主；13位年度最佳新秀得主；2位年度最佳后援投手奖得主；5位打击王；以及44位此前曾入选过全明星最佳阵容的球员，其中包括17位2025年全明星最佳阵容成员（9名第一队成员，8名第二队成员）、13位两度入选者、5位三度入选者和5位五度入选者。

items.titleEn: Scherzer's brilliance, fire and stubbornness on display in 7-K Game 162 gem
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Only one man can tell Max Scherzer when it’s over, and his name is Max Scherzer.

Every bit of Scherzer’s brilliance was on display on Sunday afternoon in what may have been his last start in the big leagues. After what we just saw, though, how could it be? How could Scherzer, one of greatest competitors this game has ever seen, put on a performance like that and not be tempted back? He’s still got it.

None of those pesky details seemed to matter as Scherzer, pitching on short rest at 42 years old, gave the Blue Jays seven-plus innings of one-run ball in Sunday's 5-1 win, striking out seven. He fell just three strikeouts shy of tying Justin Verlander for eighth on MLB’s all-time strikeout list, but perhaps that’s something to knock off in his first start of 2027. With 114 pitches, he’s the oldest Blue Jays pitcher to throw more than 100 since pitch counts began tracking in 1988.
“I felt like I was unlimited,” Scherzer said.

Scherzer has built a career on being not only remarkably talented, but supremely stubborn. Barking a manager off the mound is a lost art, but Scherzer is one of the game’s last great artists. He got to send John Schneider back to the dugout one last time, too.

When Schneider first came out of the dugout, brave and with a bounce in his step, Scherzer was at 104 pitches over 6 2/3 innings. This is a jog Schneider knows well. In Schneider’s office, there’s a photo of that famous scene in Game 4 of the 2025 ALCS in Seattle, when Scherzer convinced Schneider to keep him in the game. Scherzer has signed it for Schneider, inscribed with part of what he’d barked at his manager.

This time the home crowd booed Schneider the moment they saw him climb those dugout steps, growing angrier the closer he got to Scherzer. The veteran right-hander was a little calmer this time, but he sent Schneider right back where he came from. Walking off the field one batter later, Scherzer gave Schneider a shake of the head. Schneider couldn’t stop smiling. His face made the Reds’ caps look like a pale pink. It wasn’t time yet, and Schneider obliged.

“I’d told him before the game that I wanted to take him out in the middle of an inning so he could be recognized,” said Schneider. “The first one, I asked him how he felt and he said, ‘Great.’ I told him that if I gave him another batter and he gets him, he’d have to go back out. He said, ‘I know, and that’s what I’m doing.’ I thought, okey dokey, and I turned around.”

Schneider gave Scherzer one more batter to open the eighth, then made the long walk. This time Scherzer smiled, but he held onto the baseball just a little longer as he talked to his manager. Then, after slamming it into his glove one last time, Scherzer wrapped his arms around Schneider.

“I told Max on the mound when he was coming out, ‘Thank you for letting me be part of your unbelievable career,’” Schneider said, “’and I wouldn’t want any other 42-year-old psychopath on my team other than you.’”

Scherzer left to the loudest ovation of the night, then went down the dugout, hugging everyone he could find. Star players, rookies, interpreters, training staff, they all got a bear hug. At the other end of the dugout, Scherzer’s wife, Erica, was waiting with their kids. He climbed over the wall to get to them, the cameras still on him, the stadium still roaring around him.

“Being a Blue Jay here, it’s been great,” Scherzer said. “I had so much fun. I tell everybody across the league how much this is a hidden gem, playing for the Blue Jays. You don’t know until you experience it.”
This was a performance for baseball fans. It doesn’t matter which uniform you wear or which team you cheer for, moments like these from Scherzer are why we watch.

“I hope our young pitchers watched, because of a couple things,” said Reds manager Terry Francona. “One, I think he threw 21 first-pitch strikes, which is phenomenal. On a different note … He’s got a lot of innings under his belt. He’s coming back on short rest and did what he did. I think that shows the competitor he is. I wish we’d have won. But it’s hard not to tip your hat or clap, because he’s been so much of what’s good in baseball, and you’ve got to respect that.”
If this is it, we’ll always talk about Sunday, Sept. 27, at Rogers Centre. At the end of a season so many are eager to forget, Scherzer insisted that this day be worth remembering.
items.titleZh: Scherzer投出7K好投，展现卓越与顽强
items.summaryZh: 42岁的Max Scherzer在常规赛收官战投出7局失1分的精彩表现，多伦多蓝鸟以5比1击败对手。
bodyZh: 多伦多——只有一个人能在Max Scherzer觉得结束的时候告诉他，而那个人就是Max Scherzer。
在周日下午这场可能是他大联盟生涯最后一次先发中，Scherzer的卓越天赋展现得淋漓尽致。但在我们刚看完这样的比赛之后，怎么可能就此结束呢？像Scherzer这样这项运动史上最伟大的竞争者之一，怎么能在交出这样的表现后忍住不回来呢？他依然宝刀未老。
这些恼人的细节似乎都不重要了。42岁的Scherzer在休息天数较少的情况下登板，在周日5比1的胜利中为多伦多蓝鸟投了7局多失1分的优质投球，送出7次三振。他距离追平Justin Verlander在MLB历史三振榜上位列第八的纪录仅差3次三振，但这或许可以留他在2027年的第一场先发中去打破。他此役投了114球，成为自1988年开始统计投球数以来，单场投球超过100球的最年长多伦多蓝鸟投手。
“我觉得自己像是没有极限，”Scherzer说。
Scherzer的职业生涯不仅建立在出色的天赋上，更建立在极度的顽强之上。把总教练从投手丘上吼回去已经是一门失传的艺术，但Scherzer是这项运动最后几位伟大的艺术家之一。他也最后一次把John Schneider赶回了休息区。

当Schneider第一次勇敢且带劲地步出休息区时，Scherzer在6又2/3局中已经投了104球。这是一段Schneider非常熟悉的慢跑。在Schneider的办公室里，挂着一张2025年在西雅图进行的美联冠军赛（ALCS）第四场比赛中那个著名场面的照片，当时Scherzer说服Schneider让他在比赛中继续投下去。Scherzer还在上面为Schneider签了名，写下了他当时对总教练怒吼的部分内容。
这一次，主场球迷一看到Schneider爬上休息区台阶就报以嘘声，他离Scherzer越近，球迷就越生气。这位经验丰富的右投手这次冷静了一些，但他直接把Schneider原路遣返。一个打者之后退场时，Scherzer向Schneider摇了摇头。Schneider笑得合不拢嘴。他的表情让辛辛那提红人的球帽看起来都成了浅粉红色。时候还没到，Schneider只好顺从。
“我在赛前告诉过他，我想在局间把他换下来，这样他就能得到大家的认可，”Schneider说。“第一次，我问他感觉如何，他说‘很好’。我告诉他，如果我让他多面对一个打者而且他解决了对方，他就得继续留在场上。他说‘我知道，这就是我要做的’。我想，好吧，然后我就转过身去了。”
Schneider让Scherzer在第八局开始时多面对了一个打者，然后才迈着长步走了上来。这一次Scherzer笑了，但在与总教练交谈时，他把棒球多拿了一会儿。接着，最后一次将球拍进手套后，Scherzer双臂抱住了Schneider。
“当Max下场时，我在投手丘上对他说，‘谢谢你让我成为你不可思议职业生涯的一部分’，”Schneider说，“‘除了你之外，我绝不想让任何其他42岁的疯子在我的球队里。’”
Scherzer在全场最热烈的欢呼声中离场，随后走过休息区，拥抱了他能找到的每个人。球星、菜鸟、翻译、训练团队，人人都得到了一个熊抱。在休息区另一端，Scherzer的妻子Erica带着孩子们在等待。他翻过围墙走向他们，镜头依然对准他，球场依然环绕着轰鸣声。
“作为多伦多蓝鸟的一员，这里的体验棒极了，”Scherzer说。“我玩得太开心了。我告诉联盟里的每个人，为多伦多蓝鸟效力是一块多么被埋没的瑰宝。不亲身体验，你是不会知道的。”
这是献给棒球迷的一场表演。无论你穿着哪件球衣，无论你为哪支球队加油，Scherzer这样的时刻就是我们观看比赛的原因。

“我希望我们的年轻投手们都看了这场比赛，原因有几个，”红人总教练Terry Francona说。“第一，我认为他投了21个好球数领先（first-pitch strikes），这太惊人了。另一方面……他身上有很多投球局数。他在休息天数较少的情况下回归并且做到了他所做的事。我认为这展现了他作为竞争者的风范。我希望我们能赢。但你很难不脱帽致敬或鼓掌，因为他代表了棒球运动中如此多美好的事物，你必须对此保持敬意。”
如果这就是结局，我们总会谈论9月27日星期日罗杰斯中心的这场比赛。在一个让许多人急于忘却的赛季之末，Scherzer坚持让这一天变得值得铭记。

items.titleEn: Emotional Springer says goodbye to Toronto on Scherzer's Hall-worthy day
bodyEn: TORONTO -- George Springer once represented the beginning of something big and new. Now here he stands at the end.

It felt like the reality of this -- perhaps even the finality -- hit Springer in front of his locker on Sunday afternoon. He grabbed a fistful of the white jersey hanging beside him as he talked about it. A bat signed by his teammates leaned on the chair in front of him. One of his young sons buzzed around, weaving in and out of the crowd.
Six years after Springer signed the $150 million deal that announced the Blue Jays to the rest of baseball again, it’s his final day in this uniform.

The Blue Jays had just landed Hyun Jin Ryu a year prior, but Springer was this organization’s first blockbuster signing in decades, stretching back as far as Roger Clemens in 1997. That moment really meant something.
Six years later, Springer feels like an essential piece of this organization’s history.

“It means the world to me,” Springer said. “I told [general manager] Ross [Atkins] when I first signed that I will give you everything I’ve got, every single day. I will give you 100 percent of whatever it is I have. It doesn’t matter if I’m hurt, sick, it doesn’t matter. For me, what’s so cool is that I’m going to leave a locker room with friendships that I’ll have forever. It’s not just friendship; this is family to me. I love this place. I love it here. I’m so thankful.”

Tears were in Springer’s eyes as he said this, his voice cracking at the very end. We’ve so rarely seen this emotion out of Springer, who is an 8-year-old kid carrying a driver’s license that says he’s 37. He’s the biggest, loudest voice in that clubhouse, the life of the party on good days.

That’s the baseball world, though, where it’s easy to remain a kid. Reality has finally come knocking for Springer, who has 13 big league seasons and a World Series ring with the Astros. He doesn’t know if this will be his final game, and although there will surely be interest in him as a veteran DH this offseason around the league, Springer needs to decide whether he’ll carry on.

He and his wife, Charlise, have three sons now. Springer has taken a beating from this game, too. He’s insisted on playing out the stretch, but he’s battling just to get up the first-base line lately. He’s played this game in fifth gear for years, which takes its toll.
Asked to think how it might feel to walk out these doors later tonight, the emotion takes over again. This always felt so distant for Springer in his playing days, but it’s here now.

“It will be happy-sad, if that makes sense,” he said. “I have nothing but good things to say about this organization and the guys that I’ve played with over the last six years. I owe [president and CEO] Mark [Shapiro] and Ross a huge hug and a thank you for allowing me to be here. This has been a blessing for me. I just cannot say ‘thank you’ more.”
There were good years and bad years, great moments and challenges. With some distance, though, every conversation we ever have about Springer will begin in the same place.

With the Blue Jays down, 3-1, to the Mariners in the seventh inning of Game 7 in last year’s ALCS, Springer delivered one of the biggest moments in this franchise’s history. His three-run shot to left field gave a new generation of Blue Jays fans their very own version of Jose Bautista’s bat flip. The scene was iconic, Springer bouncing up the first-base line with his fists down at his sides, screaming up into the sky.
That World Series run fell inches short in Game 7 against the Dodgers, but baseball only creates so many of those moments. Springer owns one now, and we’ll be seeing it played for decades.

“He’s changed the trajectory of the organization,” manager John Schneider said. “He said he wanted to do that when he got here, to leave it better than when he got here. I think he’s done that. He’s meant a lot to me.”
Over and over again on Sunday, Springer kept coming back to how grateful he was. It was pouring out of him.

He reached back for a favorite memory, late in 2025, when he came back to Toronto about a month after the World Series run. He remembers fans stopping him not just for photos or autographs, but to thank him for what he and his team had done.
“I should be saying ‘thank you’ to them.”
items.titleZh: Springer在Max Scherzer名人堂级别的一天中动情告别多伦多
items.summaryZh: 效力多伦多蓝鸟六年的George Springer迎来了身披该队球衣的最后一天，他在受访时难掩不舍与感激之情。
bodyZh: 多伦多——George Springer曾代表着某种宏大且崭新事物的开端。而现在，他站在了终点。
周日下午，在更衣室里，这种现实感——甚至可能是终结感——似乎深深击中了Springer。当他谈到这一点时，他紧紧攥着挂在身旁的那件白色球衣。一把由队友签名的球棒靠在他面前的椅子上。他的一个幼子在人群中穿梭嬉戏。
在Springer签下那份价值1.5亿美元、宣告多伦多蓝鸟重新回到棒球版图中心的合同六年之后，这是他身披这件球衣的最后一天。
多伦多蓝鸟在前一年刚刚签下Hyun Jin Ryu，但Springer是这支球团几十年来第一笔重磅签约，其历史甚至可以追溯到1997年的Roger Clemens。那个时刻意义非凡。
六年过去了，Springer已成为这支球团历史中不可或缺的一部分。
“这对我意味着全世界，”Springer说道，“我刚签约时曾对总经理Ross [Atkins]说，我每天都会倾尽所有。我会百分之百付出我所拥有的一切。不管我是受伤还是生病，这都不重要。对我来说，最酷的是我将离开一个充满终身友谊的更衣室。这不仅仅是友谊，对我来说这就是家人。我爱这个地方。我爱这里。我太感激了。”
说这话时，Springer眼中泛着泪光，声音在最后哽咽了。我们很少在Springer身上看到这种情绪，他就像是一个拿着写着37岁驾照的8岁孩子。他是那个更衣室里最大、最响亮的声音，在顺境时总是派对的灵魂人物。
然而，这就是棒球世界，在这里保持童心很容易。现实终于敲响了Springer的房门，他已经征战了13个大联盟赛季，并随休斯敦太空人获得过一枚世界大赛戒指。他不知道这是否会成为他的最后一场比赛，尽管今年休赛期联盟中作为资深指定打击的他肯定不乏追求者，但Springer需要决定自己是否还要继续征战。
他和妻子Charlise现在育有三个儿子。Springer也在这项运动中饱受伤病摧残。他一直坚持打完最后阶段的比赛，但近来他仅仅是为了沿一垒边线跑动都在咬牙坚持。多年来他一直开着“五档”打球，这付出了沉重的代价。
当被问及今天晚些时候走出这些大门会有什么感受时，情绪再次占据了上风。在球员时代，这对他来说总是显得那么遥远，但现在它真的来了。
“如果可以这样形容的话，这将是苦乐参半的，”他说，“对于这支球团以及过去六年里与我并肩作战的队友们，我只有赞美之词。我要给总裁兼首席执行官Mark [Shapiro]和Ross一个大大的拥抱，并感谢他们让我来到这里。这对我来说是一种福祉。我真是感激不尽。”
有过美好的年份，也有过糟糕的年份，有过伟大的时刻，也有过挑战。不过，假以时日，我们每一次谈论Springer的对话都将从同一个地方开始。
在去年美联冠军赛第七场第七局中，多伦多蓝鸟以1-3落后于西雅图水手，Springer打出了该队历史上最伟大的时刻之一。他轰出一记飞向左外野的三分本垒打，为新一代多伦多蓝鸟球迷带来了属于他们自己的Jose Bautista式甩棒庆祝。这一幕堪称标志性，Springer双手下垂、攥紧拳头沿着一垒边线蹦跳，朝着天空呐喊。
那次世界大赛之旅在对阵洛杉矶道奇的第七场比赛中差之毫厘，但棒球运动创造的伟大时刻总是有限的。Springer如今拥有了这样一个时刻，我们将在未来几十年里反复看到它。
“他改变了球团的发展轨迹，”总教练John Schneider说，“他刚来时就说过他想做到这一点，让这里比他来时更好。我认为他做到了。他对我有很重要的意义。”
周日，Springer一次又一次地表达着他的感激之情。这种情绪从他心中倾泻而出。
他回忆起一个最喜欢的记忆，那是在2025年末，他在世界大赛之旅结束后大约一个月回到多伦多。他记得球迷们拦住他不只是为了合影或签名，而是为了感谢他和他的球队所做的一切。
“我才应该对他们说‘谢谢’。”

items.titleEn: Yesavage gets over the finish line with brief cameo to end '26
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Soon enough, we’ll be longing for an afternoon baseball game, but Saturday afternoon’s won’t be the one we romanticize.

The Blue Jays lost to the Reds, 5-1, on a quiet afternoon at Rogers Centre, teeing up the season finale on Sunday with Max Scherzer taking the mound in what could be his final MLB appearance, but the future Hall of Famer hasn’t decided just yet.
This is what mattered most:
1. Trey Yesavage says goodbye to 2026
The Blue Jays only asked Yesavage for two innings on 30 pitches Saturday, not wanting to push him any further after Yesavage ramped up quickly in hopes of a postseason run.

Yesavage posted a 3.69 ERA over 97 2/3 innings this season, losing a month off the top due to a shoulder impingement, and later losing six weeks after undergoing left knee surgery to repair his meniscus. This wasn’t an ideal year by any means for Yesavage, but he should enter 2027 fully healthy and is still just 23 years old, loaded with upside.
“I’d like to limit the walks, then hopefully add a fourth pitch to the mix,” Yesavage said.
Yesavage lives on his fastball and excellent splitter, mixing in a slider, so a fourth pitch is a great project for him to take that next step.
“I’m dabbling around with a curveball or a two-seamer,” Yesavage said, “but we’ll see what works best.”
2. What does the 2027 rotation look like?

If the season started tomorrow, the Blue Jays would roll out a top three of Dylan Cease, José Soriano and Yesavage. That’s a fine place to start, especially if the Blue Jays get the version of Soriano they’re expecting.

Beyond that, Cody Ponce will be back from his ACL injury, but coming off what’s essentially been a lost season, how much of a workload will he have? There’s also the potential for José Berríos or Bowden Francis to return later in the season, along with prospects making the jump and the high likelihood that the Blue Jays acquire another mid-rotation starter. If we learned anything this season, it’s that “too many starting pitchers” is never possible.
The wild card? Spencer Miles. The Rule 5 wonder has been one of the best stories of 2026 in a variety of roles, but he has “starter” written all over him.
“We’re trying to find the perfect spot for the number of innings we want to get him to next year,” manager John Schneider said. “Then, how do we do that and what role do we do that in?”

Miles threw an inning Saturday, leaving him with a 2.63 ERA over 95 2/3 innings in his rookie season. All of this comes after he’d barely pitched in the lower Minor League levels prior to being selected in the Rule 5, so it’s already extremely impressive that he’s made this much of a jump in workload. The next steps will need to be handled carefully.

“When you look at where he is now, you tack on 20-30 [innings] to that next year,” Schneider said. “If all goes well in the offseason, that could turn into a No. 5 starter, just in terms of managing his workload. I think he has the stuff to do it. You have to be pretty convicted in a plan based on his background.”
3. Status check: Ernie Clement

Clement is a fan favorite for good reason and looked great through the first four months of the season, but things have gone downhill since the first of August. Clement came into that month with an OPS of .738, but that’s since fallen to .652 and he’s homered just once over the past two months.

“He’s played a lot. I wonder, ‘Did I play him too much in the second half?’” Schneider said. “I think he was, at times, trying to swing his way out of it. Then, you lead yourself down a path of swinging at bad pitches. We know that Ernie can hit everything, but he was really good early in the season on narrowing the strike zone, and I think that got a bit bigger as the season went on.”

Clement still profiles as someone who could play 150 games for the Blue Jays next season, but whether that comes as a full-time second-baseman or with some more utility opportunities remains to be seen.
items.titleZh: Yesavage短暂登场结束2026赛季
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟以1比5不敌辛辛那提红人，Trey Yesavage在周六完成本季最后登场。
bodyZh: 多伦多——很快，我们将开始怀念下午场的棒球比赛，但周六下午这场比赛不会是我们所浪漫化的那场。
在罗杰斯中心一个安静的下午，多伦多蓝鸟以1比5不敌辛辛那提红人，这也为周日的常规赛收官战做好了铺垫。Max Scherzer将在该场比赛先发登场，这很可能是他职业生涯最后一次在大联盟亮相，不过这位未来的名人堂成员尚未最终决定。
以下是几个最重要的看点：
1. Trey Yesavage告别2026赛季
蓝鸟在周六对Yesavage的使用仅限于2局30球，由于他在冲击季后赛的希望驱使下此前迅速加量，球队不想再过度催促他。
Yesavage本季在97 2/3局的投球中交出3.69自责分率，赛季初期因肩部夹挤缺阵一个月，随后又因左膝半月板手术缺阵六周。对Yesavage而言这绝不是理想的一年，但他进入2027赛季时将完全恢复健康，且年仅23岁，极具成长潜力。
“我想减少保送，然后希望能加入第四种球路，”Yesavage说道。
Yesavage主要依靠他的直球和出色的指叉球，并掺杂滑球，因此开发第四种球路对他迈向下一步是一个很棒的课题。
“我正在尝试曲球或两缝线直球，”Yesavage说，“但我们要看看哪种效果最好。”
2. 2027年先发轮值会是什么样？
如果明天就开打新赛季，蓝鸟的前三号先发将是Dylan Cease、José Soriano和Yesavage。这是一个不错的起点，特别是如果蓝鸟能得到他们预期中的那个Soriano的话。
除此之外，Cody Ponce将从前交叉韧带伤势中回归，但由于他经历了一个基本上等于报销的赛季，他的工作量会有多少？此外还有José Berríos或Bowden Francis可能在赛季晚些时候回归，以及小联盟潜力新秀的升上大联盟，并且蓝鸟极有可能再引进一名中段先发投手。如果我们从本赛季学到了什么，那就是“拥有太多先发投手”永远是不可能的。
变数是什么？Spencer Miles。这位规则五选秀的奇迹在2026年扮演了各种角色，并打出了最佳故事之一，但他身上完全写着“先发投手”的标签。
“我们正在为他明年的投球局数寻找一个完美的数字，”总教练John Schneider说，“然后，我们如何做到这一点，以及以什么角色去达成？”
Miles在周六投了一局，他在新秀赛季的95 2/3局投球中自责分率定格在2.63。这一切都发生在他通过规则五选秀被选中之前几乎没有在低阶小联盟投过球的背景下，因此他能在工作量上有如此大的跨越已经令人印象深刻。接下来的步骤需要谨慎处理。
“当你看看他现在的处境，明年再给他加上20到30局，”Schneider说，“如果休赛期一切顺利，从管理他的工作量来看，这可能会演变成一位5号先发投手。我认为他有这样的球威。根据他的背景，你必须对一个计划相当坚定。”
3. 现状检查：Ernie Clement
Clement由于出色的表现深受球迷喜爱，他在赛季前四个月表现亮眼，但自8月1日以来情况有所下滑。Clement进入那个月时的上垒加长打率（OPS）为.738，但此后降至.652，且过去两个月里他只打出过一支本垒打。
“他打了很多比赛。我在想，‘我在下半场是不是让他打得太多了？’”Schneider说。“我认为他在某些时候试图通过挥棒来摆脱低迷。然后，你就会走上一条去打坏球的绝路。我们知道Ernie什么球都能打，但他在赛季初时很好地缩小了好球带，我认为随着赛季进行，这一点有些放大了。”
Clement在球队的定位依然是下赛季能为蓝鸟出战150场的球员，但这究竟是以全职二垒手身份出战，还是获得更多全能替补机会，目前还有待观察。

items.titleEn: As Verlander hangs up cleats, he and Scherzer have one last matter to settle
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The sun is setting on two of this era’s greatest pitchers. Justin Verlander threw the final pitch of his remarkable career on Saturday afternoon in Detroit, and while Max Scherzer isn’t ready to make a decision just yet, he’ll take the mound Sunday in Toronto knowing it could be his last time.

These two have combined for 490 wins, 6,617 1/3 innings and six Cy Young Awards over 40 years of big league experience. So many of those years were spent jockeying for the title of the best pitcher in baseball, including the five years they spent together in Detroit.
Who is the greatest pitcher of this generation? It's time to debate

From 2010-14, Verlander and Scherzer were part of those great Tigers teams together, Verlander winning his MVP and first Cy Young in ‘11 before Scherzer won his first Cy Young in ‘13. Their final season together, in ‘14, Verlander was once again the Tigers’ Opening Day starter and Scherzer pitched right behind him in Game 2.

All these years later, they still can’t escape one another. After Verlander struck out six batters over 5 1/3 innings in the final start of his career Saturday, he’s got a 10-strikeout lead on Scherzer on the all-time leaderboard.
MLB all-time strikeout leaders:
8. Justin Verlander (3,560)9. Max Scherzer (3,550)

Over the past couple of weeks, as Verlander decided to make one final start and the Blue Jays left the door cracked open to Scherzer pitching on the final day of the season, this leaderboard has been everywhere. Does Verlander just want to give himself a better shot at staying ahead of his old teammate? Does Scherzer want to empty the tank to catch him?
Neither of the expected future Hall of Famers seem to care, or at least they’re not saying it out loud.

“Look, [that's] never why I played. I don't pitch for strikeouts,” Verlander said. “I love the volume. It was never on my mind … It seems to be more of a narrative that's naturally presenting itself. It has nothing to do with why I'm going out there to pitch. We're both naturally competitive people, and I don't want to speak for Max, but I'm sure that's not why he's taking the ball either. We want to pitch when we can, and that's that.”

Verlander knows his old teammate well. On Saturday afternoon, Scherzer met with the media just minutes before Verlander took the mound down in Detroit and shared that he wasn’t decided on his future yet, but he wasn’t biting on the idea he was still chasing Verlander.
“That has nothing to do with it,” Scherzer said, grinning. “Everybody’s going to make a big deal about it, but that’s not the motivation to pitch tomorrow. It’s about competing and having fun.”

Scherzer is a baseball nut, though, who holds a deep appreciation for its history. Even when he passed Walter Johnson to move into the top 10 earlier this year, he spoke at length about the man he’d just passed, who last pitched in the Major Leagues in 1927. This means something to Scherzer, so he can at least recognize how special this tie is between him and Verlander.
“It’s funny how that’s unfolding,” Scherzer said. “Here we are, all these years later, we’re neck-and-neck in that regard. I hope he goes out there and strikes out the world today.”

Hip and hamstring injuries have kept Verlander on the IL all season until Saturday, while Scherzer has dealt with thumb, forearm, back and ankle injuries this season. Scherzer is 42 and Verlander is 43, and these things tend to happen when you pitch this long.

“I’ve texted him over the past day,” Scherzer said. “I know he’s definitely at his end, and I’m definitely looking forward to going out there and seeing him pitch. For everything he’s done in the game and accomplished, it’s going to be a big moment for him. I really enjoyed being able to watch him get back out there one more time.”

Perhaps Sunday is Scherzer’s “one more time”, and in five years, they’ll be inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame together. It still feels like the ultra-competitive Scherzer has one more season left in him, though, and maybe a couple more names to pass on that all-time strikeout list.
Whichever order these names end up in, Verlander and Scherzer belong side by side. For the better part of the past two decades, that’s where they’ve been.
items.titleZh: 当Verlander挂靴退役，他和Scherzer还有最后一件事要解决
items.summaryZh: 随着Verlander在底特律完成职业生涯最后一次登板，他和Scherzer在历史三振榜上的竞争成为焦点。
bodyZh: 多伦多——这个时代最伟大的两位投手正迎来职业生涯的尾声。Justin Verlander于周六下午在底特律投出了他非凡职业生涯的最后一球，而Max Scherzer虽然尚未决定未来，但他将在周日于多伦多站上投手丘，深知这可能是他的最后一次。
在长达40年的大联盟生涯中，两人合计斩获490场胜利、投球局数达6,617 1/3局，并荣膺6次赛扬奖。他们有许多年都在争夺棒球界最佳投手的头衔，其中包括两人在底特律并肩作战的五年。
谁是这个时代最伟大的投手？现在是时候展开讨论了
从2010年到2014年，Verlander和Scherzer曾一同效力于那支伟大的底特律老虎队。Verlander在2011年赢得了常规赛MVP和他的第一座赛扬奖，随后Scherzer在2013年赢得了他的第一座赛扬奖。在他们并肩作战的最后一个赛季（2014年），Verlander再次担任底特律老虎的開幕戰先發投手，而Scherzer则紧随其后在第2场比赛中登板。
多年后的今天，他们依然无法摆脱彼此。周六，Verlander在职业生涯的最后一场先发中投了5 1/3局并送出6次三振，这使他在历史三振榜上领先Scherzer 10次三振。
MLB历史三振排行榜：
8. Justin Verlander (3,560) 9. Max Scherzer (3,550)
在过去几周里，随着Verlander决定进行最后一次先发，多伦多蓝鸟也为Scherzer在赛季最后一天登板留出了空间，这份三振榜随处可见。Verlander只是想为自己保住对老队友的领先优势增加更多胜算吗？Scherzer是否想拼尽全力去追赶他？
这两位未来的名人堂成员似乎并不在意，或者至少他们没有大声说出来。
“听着，我从来都不是为了这个而打球的。我投球不是为了三振，”Verlander说道。“我热爱投球的局数。这从来不在我的脑海里……这似乎更多是一个自然而然出现的话题。这与我为什么走上投手丘没有任何关系。我们俩天生都极具竞争力，我不想替Max代言，但我确信这也是他登板的原因。我们想在能够投球的时候上场投球，就是这样。”
Verlander非常了解他的老队友。周六下午，Scherzer在Verlander于底特律登板前几分钟会见了媒体，他分享说自己尚未决定未来，但也并不认为自己还在追逐Verlander。
“这毫无关系，”Scherzer笑着说。“每个人都会把这炒得沸沸扬扬，但这不是明天登板的动力。动力在于竞争和享受乐趣。”
不过，Scherzer是个狂热的棒球迷，对历史有着深深的敬意。甚至在今年早些时候超越Walter Johnson进入前十名时，他也曾长篇大谈这位最后一次在大联盟登板还是在1927年的前辈。这对Scherzer意义重大，因此他至少能意识到他和Verlander之间的这种羁绊有多么特殊。
“事情的发展真是有趣，”Scherzer说。“多年后的今天，我们在这方面不相上下。我希望他今天能上场把所有人都三振出局。”
臀部和大腿伤势让Verlander整个赛季都处于伤病名单中，直到周六才复出，而Scherzer本赛季则饱受拇指、前臂、背部和脚踝伤病的困扰。Scherzer已经42岁，Verlander则为43岁，当你投球这么长时间时，这些伤病往往不可避免。
“过去几天我给他发了短信，”Scherzer说。“我知道他的职业生涯确实已经接近尾声，我也非常期待能去现场看他投球。鉴于他为这项运动所做的一切和取得的成就，这将是他人生中的一个重大时刻。我真的很享受能够再次看他重返投手丘。”
或许周日就是Scherzer的“最后一次”，而在五年后，他们将一起入选棒球名人堂。不过，极具好胜心的Scherzer看起来似乎还剩下一个赛季的油，或许还可以在历史三振榜上超越更多名字。
无论这些名字最终以怎样的顺序排列，Verlander和Scherzer都将并肩站在一起。在过去二十年的大部分时间里，他们一直都在那里。
items.author: Keegan Matheson

items.titleEn: Scherzer to wait on retirement decision, wants to 'see how things unfold'
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Max Scherzer still rocks back and forth and bounces when he talks about baseball. The topic alone electrifies him.

Scherzer said Saturday at Rogers Centre that he’s not going to make any decisions yet on his future, but it’s so clear that this game gives him something irreplaceable. As a pitcher, he’s one of the greatest who’s ever lived. As a competitor, he’s one of one. The end is near, but the 42-year-old Scherzer isn’t ready to say if it’s time just yet.

“I’m going to make this decision about playing next year later in the offseason,” Scherzer said. “I’ve gone through ups and downs throughout the season, I get it, but I’ve gotten to the point where I’m pretty healthy. I’ve talked to everybody in my inner circle and we all kind of feel the same way. We don’t need to make a decision today. Get to the offseason and see how things unfold.”

Scherzer is extremely likely to be a Baseball Hall of Famer, a pitching giant who stands alongside Justin Verlander and Clayton Kershaw as the faces of this generation on the mound. He’s ninth all-time in strikeouts (3,550), still chasing Verlander with one start left in Sunday’s finale.

There are so many ways Scherzer could go about this next year. When his playing days are over, Scherzer wants to get involved in youth and amateur sports, coaching his kids and his friends’ kids. We’re not only talking about baseball here, but basketball and football, too. He’s passionate about the idea that young kids should be playing sports, not just specializing in one, and he wants to be part of that. There will also be the pull of business interests, coaching, broadcasting, ownership stakes, you name it. He’ll have every option in the world.

If he pitches, he could join a team in camp or even kick it down the road a bit longer, waiting for the perfect situation early in the season or midway through. For now, Scherzer insists that this is all still up in the air.

“I have no idea how I’m going to feel here in six months,” Scherzer said. “For me, right now it’s just about being healthy, pitching in this last game and having fun with it, then seeing what happens. I really don’t have any expectations of what happens. Pitching is so much fun. You never know. Really, I have no idea.”

Scherzer’s two seasons in Toronto will be remembered for a handful of moments on the field, like when he barked John Schneider off the mound in Game 4 of the 2025 ALCS in Seattle, but more for what he brought to this organization and clubhouse. Scherzer posted a 5.64 ERA over these two seasons and dealt with multiple injuries, but he’s left an impact on the young pitchers and set a standard with his intensity and competitiveness.
He lights up talking about last year’s run, too. He’s a baseball nut. Listening to him, it’s hard to believe he’ll call it a career just yet.

“That is such a memory. Game 7 of the World Series, there is just nothing better than that,” Scherzer said. “That is baseball at its pinnacle. To be having that ball in that situation, competing like that and the way we played, that’s just a lifelong memory. That’s a baseball memory. I’ve had so many great memories in my career, yet here I am at 41, having one of my best memories in baseball pitching in Game 7 of the World Series in Toronto.”

Sunday will come on short rest for Scherzer, but with the Blue Jays eliminated, there’s some room for good stories. It will likely be Scherzer calling the shots, going as deep as he’s comfortable going, and if Verlander is still within reach for eighth all-time on the strikeout list, maybe that line gets pushed a little further.

“I just want to go out there and pitch tomorrow, knowing that you never know, it could be my last,” Scherzer said. “Just in case. We’ve been eyeing this on the calendar for a couple of weeks now, knowing I was going to make the start in Baltimore, but the kids were in school so we weren’t able to get them to Baltimore. We had circled this one, if we were out of it, to still pitch Sunday. It gives me a chance to pitch in front of my kids one more time, if it is [the end]. If it’s not, who knows?”
items.titleZh: Scherzer 暂缓退役决定，希望“看看事态如何发展”
items.summaryZh: Max Scherzer 表示尚未对未来做出退役决定，将在休赛期再做打算。
bodyZh: 多伦多——当谈到棒球时，Max Scherzer 总是会激动得前后摇晃、兴奋不已。仅仅是这个话题就能让他充满活力。
Scherzer 周六在罗杰斯中心表示，他尚未对自己的未来做出任何决定，但很显然，这项运动赋予了他无可替代的东西。作为一名投手，他是史上最伟大的投手之一；作为一名竞争者，他是独一无二的。终点已经临近，但现年 42 岁的 Scherzer 还没准备好宣布这是否就是终点。
“我将在今年稍后的休赛期再决定明年是否继续打球，”Scherzer 表示，“我经历过赛季中的起起落落，我明白这一点，但我已经恢复到了相当健康的状况。我与核心圈子里的所有人都谈过，大家的想法都差不多。我们今天不需要做出决定，等到休赛期看看事态如何发展。”
Scherzer 极有希望入选棒球名人堂，他是与 Justin Verlander 和 Clayton Kershaw 齐名的这一代投手巨星。他的生涯三振数（3,550 次）位居历史第九，在周日的收官战中，他将带着最后一次先发继续追赶 Justin Verlander。
Scherzer 明年有多种选择。当他的球员生涯结束时，Scherzer 希望参与到青少年和业余体育运动中，执教他的孩子和朋友的孩子。这里不仅指棒球，还包括篮球和橄榄球。他热衷于这样一种理念：小球员们应该参与多项运动，而不只是专注于一项，他希望成为其中的一部分。此外，他还面临着商业利益、执教、转播、球队股权等各种吸引力，应有尽有。他将拥有全世界所有的选择。
如果他继续投球，他可以加入一支春训营球队，或者将时间稍微推迟一些，在赛季初或中期寻找完美的契机。就目前而言，Scherzer 坚称这一切都尚未敲定。
“我完全不知道自己六个月后的感觉会如何，”Scherzer 表示，“对我来说，现在最重要的是保持健康，在最后一场比赛中投球并享受其中，然后看会发生什么。我对接下来会发生什么没有任何预期。投球太有趣了。你永远猜不到，说实话，我完全不知道。”
Scherzer 在多伦多的两个赛季将因场上的少数精彩时刻而被人们铭记，比如在西雅图举行的 2025 年美联冠军赛第四场中，他将 John Schneider 吼下投手丘，但更让人记住的是他为这支球队和更衣室带来的东西。在这两个赛季中，Scherzer 的自责分率达到 5.64，并多次遭遇伤病，但他对年轻投手产生了深远的影响，并用他的强度和好胜心树立了标准。
当谈到去年的季后赛征程时，他同样光彩照人。他是个棒球狂热分子。听他这么说，很难相信他会这么快就结束职业生涯。
“那真是难忘的回忆。世界大赛第七场，没有什么比这更好的了，”Scherzer 表示，“那是棒球的巅峰。在那种情况下握着那颗球，像那样去竞争，以及我们比赛的方式，这绝对是一生难忘的回忆。这是一段棒球记忆。我的职业生涯有过那么多美好的回忆，然而现在我 41 岁了，在多伦多世界大赛第七场投球，留下了我职业生涯中最美好的棒球回忆之一。”
对于 Scherzer 来说，周日的比赛将是在休息时间不足的情况下登场，但随着多伦多蓝鸟被淘汰，这也留下了成就美好故事的空间。这很可能由 Scherzer 自己作主，只要他觉得舒适就会尽量多投几局，如果 Justin Verlander 在历史三振榜上第八的位置依然触手可及，也许他的投球数还会再多推进一点。
“我明天只想上场投球，因为你永远不知道这会不会是我的最后一场比赛，”Scherzer 说，“以防万一。几周前我们就在日历上关注着这个日子，知道我要在巴尔的摩先发，但孩子们当时在上学，所以我们没能让他们去巴尔的摩。如果我们已经无缘季后赛，我们就圈定了这场比赛，以便在周日继续投球。如果这真的是[终点]，这也给了我在孩子们面前再投一次球的机会。如果不是，谁知道呢？”

items.titleEn: Have you ever seen a double-hit like this?
bodyEn: Talk about getting the barrel on it.
Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. technically squared up his RBI single in the seventh inning of Friday's 6-5 win over the Reds at Rogers Centre, but he did it in quite an unusual way.
On an 0-2 sinker from Cincinnati reliever Luis Mey, Guerrero chopped a ground ball toward the middle, breaking his bat in the process. Then, pure baseball magic took over.

Slow-motion replay showed exactly what happened: The severed barrel of Guerrero's bat connected with the baseball several feet in front of home plate, redirecting the ball toward the right side of the infield. It rolled through a hole in the Reds' defense and into right field for a single, scoring Andrés Giménez from second base.

Guerrero's hit, which brought in the first run of a pivotal four-run seventh to give Toronto the lead and eventually the win, was far from the first base hit on which a player hit the ball twice. In fact, it was at least the sixth this season -- including two on the same day.
While it surely wasn't the hard contact Guerrero envisioned, Friday's double-hit allowed him to "hit 'em where they ain't" in a truly ingenious way.
items.titleZh: 你见过这样的连续击球吗？
items.summaryZh: Vladimir Guerrero Jr.在比赛中罕见地单局击出神奇的一安打。
bodyZh: 谈谈如何完美咬中球心。
在周五罗杰斯中心以6比5战胜辛辛那提红人的比赛中，多伦多蓝鸟一垒手Vladimir Guerrero Jr.在第七局技术性地敲出了一支带有一分打点的安打，但他的方式相当不同寻常。
面对来自辛辛那提后援投手Luis Mey的0坏球2好球伸卡球，Guerrero将球向中路砍击，并在过程中打断了自己的球棒。随后，纯粹的棒球魔术上演了。
慢动作回放准确展示了发生的一切：Guerrero断掉的球棒在本垒板前方几英尺处再次击中了棒球，将球的轨迹改变到了内场右侧。它穿过了红人防守的空当滚入右外野形成安打，送回了二垒上的Andrés Giménez。
Guerrero这支安打带来了决定性的第七局四分大局中的第一分，帮助多伦多取得领先并最终赢得胜利，这远不是球员两次击中棒球的第一支安打。事实上，这至少本赛季的第六次——包括同一天出现的两次。
虽然这绝对不是Guerrero所设想的扎实击球，但周五的这次双重击打让他以一种真正巧妙的方式“把球打到防守空当去”。

items.titleEn: Okamoto paces Blue Jays' offense as spectacular rookie year continues
bodyEn: TORONTO -- After Vladimir Guerrero Jr. kicked off the day with a public apology for his recent comments about his $500 million contract, it felt like everything else would live in that shadow.
The Blue Jays pulled off a comeback win, though, 6-5 over the Reds, rewarding their fans who packed Rogers Centre yet again despite their team being eliminated from postseason contention.
This is what mattered most:
1. Okamoto running away with major categories

Kazuma Okamoto ripped a bases-loaded double off the wall in left-center to tie this one, his second double of the night to continue what’s been a spectacular rookie season in Major League Baseball. Okamoto isn’t just leading the Blue Jays in home runs and RBIs, he’s towering above everyone else through 160 games.
“I’ve obviously learned a lot,” Okamoto said through interpreter Yusuke Oshima. “The numbers are the numbers. I can also improve on the numbers, as well.”
Home runs:1. Kazuma Okamoto -- 332. George Springer -- 15T-3. Alejandro Kirk -- 10T-3. Nathan Lukes -- 10
RBIs:1. Kazuma Okamoto -- 922. Andrés Giménez -- 583. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. -- 57

Yes, you’re reading that correctly -- only two Blue Jays hitters have more than 10 home runs this season, and Okamoto has more than doubled the second-highest total in that category. It’s a leaderboard we’ll look back on a few years from now with confusion and amazement, but that’s for another day.

On a team absolutely starved for positive stories offensively, Okamoto has been everything the Blue Jays could have hoped for and more. His four-year, $60 million deal looks like excellent business for this organization, and while he’s also set the franchise record with 180 strikeouts, his power is so important to this roster that it’s almost easy to shrug at that number at this point.

“He’s been impressive. It's a long season for everyone, but especially him in his first year over here. He’s been fantastic,” manager John Schneider said. “He’s preparing, adjusting and showing the hitter he is. Man, he’s been fantastic.”
2. A disappointing finale for Soriano
José Soriano lasted just three innings, allowing five runs, and there wasn’t much value in pushing him further than that given that there’s nothing at stake.

In 10 starts with the Blue Jays, Soriano has posted a 5.30 ERA, a jump from the 3.29 ERA he’d owned with the Angels prior to the deal (123 IP). The true version of Soriano is much closer to what he did with the Angels, of course, and he has the talent to pitch near the front of this rotation, behind Dylan Cease and alongside Trey Yesavage.
“We are excited as hell about his potential going forward,” Schneider said.

This isn’t the stretch of 10 starts the Blue Jays were hoping for, and this wasn’t the note they wanted the 27-year-old to end on. Once we settle into the offseason and begin to look toward 2027, Soriano will be a popular name when we discuss how this team can improve.
3. What’s the long-term plan for Soriano?
Soriano was the Blue Jays’ big addition at the Trade Deadline, and while his 10 starts down the stretch have been average at best, this move was made with an eye on 2027 and ‘28.

The Blue Jays have a “type,” and Soriano fits it. Look back at Hyun Jin Ryu, Kevin Gausman, José Berríos, Chris Bassitt, Cease and others. All of them were established in the big leagues, but the Blue Jays like to target talented, reliable starters, then try to tinker just the right amount to get a bit more out of them.

That’s already begun with Soriano, but there was no immediate success story, like the club had with Robbie Ray in his brief time here. Even Cease has shown that immediate and obvious “leap,” but Soriano looks like more of an offseason project as the Blue Jays try to massage in their own ideas to the talent he already has.

“Guys with that kind of talent and those kinds of pitches, you have to let them do their thing,” Schneider said pregame. “Our job is just to find the best way to use them. He’s been really open and receptive to it. You can see how much we’re leaning into his two-seamer as opposed to the four-seamer, but he’s been really good so far."
items.titleZh: Okamoto延续出色菜鸟赛季，率领多伦多蓝鸟进攻
items.summaryZh: Okamoto表现出色带领多伦多蓝鸟逆转辛辛那提红人。
bodyZh: TORONTO -- 在Vladimir Guerrero Jr.就其关于5亿美元合同的近期言论公开道歉开启这一天后，感觉其他一切都将笼罩在那片阴影之下。
不过多伦多蓝鸟还是完成了一场逆转，以6-5击败辛辛那提红人，回馈了尽管球队已无缘季后赛但依然挤满罗杰斯中心的球迷们。
这是最重要的事情：
1. Okamoto在各大主要数据上遥遥领先
Kazuma Okamoto在左中外野墙前轰出一支满垒二垒安打追平比分，这是他当晚的第二支二垒安打，延续了他在美国职棒大联盟极其出色的菜鸟赛季。Okamoto不仅在多伦多蓝鸟队内领跑本垒打和打点数，在经历160场比赛后，他的数据更是远远甩开其他人。
“我显然学到了很多，”Okamoto通过翻译Yusuke Oshima表示。“数据就是数据。我也还可以在数据上继续提升。”
本垒打：1. Kazuma Okamoto -- 33; 2. George Springer -- 15; T-3. Alejandro Kirk -- 10; T-3. Nathan Lukes -- 10
打点：1. Kazuma Okamoto -- 92; 2. Andrés Giménez -- 58; 3. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. -- 57
是的，你没看错——本赛季多伦多蓝鸟阵中只有两名打者的本垒打数超过10个，而Okamoto的本垒打数是第二高的两倍多。几年后我们回看这份榜单时可能会感到困惑和惊叹，但那是后话了。
对于一支进攻端极度渴望正面新闻的球队来说，Okamoto的表现达到了多伦多蓝鸟所能希望的全部甚至更多。他那份4年6000万美元的合同对这个组织而言是一笔极佳的运作，尽管他也创造了队史纪录的180次三振，但他的长打火力对这支阵容而言如此重要，以至于在这个阶段几乎可以让人对这个数字一笑置之。
“他一直令人印象深刻。对每个人来说这都是漫长的一季，尤其是对他这位初来乍到的第一年球员而言。他太棒了，”总教练John Schneider说道。“他在准备、调整并展现出他作为一名打者的实力。天呐，他实在太棒了。”
2. Soriano令人失望的收官战
José Soriano仅仅投了三局就失五分，考虑到已经没有战绩压力，再让他多投也没有太多价值。
在为多伦多蓝鸟先发的10场比赛中，Soriano的自责分率达到了5.30，这比他在交易截止日前效力洛杉矶天使时的3.29自责分率（投了123局）有所上升。当然，真正的Soriano要更接近他在洛杉矶天使时的表现，并且他有天赋在Dylan Cease身后、Trey Yesavage身旁担任前段轮值投手。
“我们对他的未来潜力感到无比兴奋，”Schneider说道。
这不是多伦多蓝鸟所期望的10场先发，也不是他们希望这位27岁球员以之结束赛季的方式。一旦我们进入休赛期并开始展望2027年，当讨论这支球队如何改进时，Soriano将会是一个热门名字。
3. Soriano的长期计划是什么？
Soriano是多伦多蓝鸟在交易截止日期的重要引援，尽管他在尾声阶段的10场先发充其量只能算一般，但这一运作着眼于2027年和2028年。
多伦多蓝鸟有他们的“类型”，而Soriano契合这一类型。回看柳贤振、Kevin Gausman、José Berríos、Chris Bassitt、Cease等人。他们都在大联盟证明过自己，但多伦多蓝鸟喜欢瞄准有天赋、可靠的先发投手，然后尝试进行恰到好处的微调，从中榨取更多潜力。
这已经在Soriano身上开始了，但并没有像俱乐部当年短暂停留的Robbie Ray那样取得立竿见影的成功。甚至Cease也展现出了那种即刻而明显的“飞跃”，但Soriano看起来更像是一个休赛期的改造项目，多伦多蓝鸟正试图将他们自己的理念融入他现有的天赋中。
“拥有那种天赋和那些球路的球员，你必须让他们按自己的方式去做，”Schneider在赛前说道。“我们的工作只是找到使用他们的最佳方式。他一直非常开放和乐于接受。你可以看到我们有多么倾向于使用他的二缝线速球而不是四缝线速球，但他到目前为止表现得非常好。”

items.titleEn: Vlad Jr. apologizes to fans: 'Not really what I wanted to say'
bodyEn: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. apologized Friday for his recent controversial comments about his 14-year, $500 million contract.

“I feel that the comments I made the other day is not what I really wanted to say,” Guerrero said via team interpreter Hector Lebron. “Everyone deserves an apology from me. … I want to tell everyone that I’m going to continue to keep working hard to make my contract a great one.”
Guerrero also said his Hall of Fame father told him he had made a mistake and needed to apologize for what he said regarding his contract.

In a recent Spanish-language interview with Veronica Batista earlier this week, Guerrero Jr. said that the Blue Jays “didn’t pay me because I’m going to hit 40 [home runs] every year. They paid me for what I already accomplished.”
Guerrero was then asked about those comments on Wednesday, after the Blue Jays had been mathematically eliminated from the postseason, and he stood by what he said.

"No, I don't regret myself. I'm not lying with what I say,” Guerrero said then via Lebron. “I understand some fans, they don't understand the way and what I was trying to say specifically, but what I said is the way I feel."

Guerrero is in the final weekend of what has been a frustrating season for him. Statistically, he has put up the worst numbers of his career, highlighted by a .263 average, a 92 OPS+ (100 is league average) and just nine home runs through 142 games. He has also been nagged by injuries for much of the season, including back trouble, and spent some time on the concussion injured list last month.

items.summaryZh: Vlad Jr.为自己此前引发争议的合同言论公开道歉。
bodyZh: Vladimir Guerrero Jr.于周五为他最近关于自己14年5亿美元合同的争议言论公开道歉。
“我觉得我那天说的话并不是我真正想表达的，”Guerrero通过球队翻译Hector Lebron表示。“每个人都值得得到我的道歉……我想告诉大家，我会继续努力工作，让我的合同成为一份伟大的合同。”
Guerrero还表示，他的名人堂父亲告诉他自己犯了错误，并需要为关于合同的言论道歉。
在本周早些时候接受Veronica Batista的西班牙语采访时，Guerrero Jr.曾表示，多伦多蓝鸟“没有因为我每年能轰出40个本垒打而付给我薪水。他们付钱是为了我过去已经取得的成就。”
周三，在多伦多蓝鸟在数学上确定无缘季后赛之后，Guerrero被问及这些言论，当时他坚持了自己的说法。
“不，我并不后悔。我说的话不是谎言，”Guerrero当时通过Lebron表示。“我理解有些球迷不明白我的方式以及我具体想表达什么，但我所说的话就是我的真实感受。”
Guerrero正迎来对他而言令人沮丧的赛季的最后一个周末。从数据上看，他交出了职业生涯最糟糕的表现，在142场比赛中打击率为.263，OPS+为92（联盟平均为100），仅敲出9支本垒打。在整个赛季的大部分时间里，他还饱受背部等伤病困扰，并在上个月因脑震荡进入伤病名单。
